main_text.p: nunc fit, iuuenilis illa ætas tua tangeretur aut contaminaretur. Quod si licentius quandoque tecum, quàm par erat, fui iocatus: permissum id fuit artificium in Collegiis nostris, eo quasi dulcore discipulos adsuefacere, vt & promtius praeceptoribus obœdiant, & studiis diligentius incumbant. Impulsus praeterea ad hoc fui nimio illo amore, quo salutis tuæ caussa ergá te ducebar, atq; etiamnum ducor; noh[?] autem eo fine, vt te offenderem, aut contumelia afficerem. Sit itaque iam finis tantæ tuæ absentiæ, & instar filii illius prodigi ad Patrem tuum spiritualem & Magistrum reuertere. Recordare, te mortalem esse, & extra hunc Societatis nostræ numerum paucos, aut forte neminem saluari posse. Imple vota & promissa: & peccatum tuum cognoscens, Dei vindictam effuge:

page.notes: The printed ornament below the text (a cross-and-brace device with a small flourish under it) is a typographic decoration and is not transcribed. Below it at the foot of the scan is show-through from the reverse side and a faint ruled line; these are not transcribed. No catchword, signature or marginal notes are printed on this page. Doubtful: "noh" in "noh autem eo fine" may be "non"; marked [?]. The running head's trailing colon is as printed.
